description: Static pair kernel dump before any dynamics. Two particles, equal charge.

formula.U: U(r) = coulombK * (q1*q2 / r) * exp(-r / lambda_D)   for 0 < r <= cutoff; else 0
formula.F_mag: |F| = |dU/dr|  (pair force magnitude on either particle, nm-unit continuum)
formula.r_floor: r_eff = max(r, r_min=0.12 nm) for numerical stability (not hit at r>=1.0)

evaluations_before_dynamics.force_direction_note: Like charges: F repulsive (particles pushed apart); |F| = |dU/dr|
